ValidationRule.description: If customer consented to data collection, his/her names should be captured.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint', IDR_NC_Is_Consent_Obtained__c = true, OR( ISBLANK(IDR_NC_First_Name__c ), IDR_NC_First_Name__c = $Label.Anonymous_Complainant, ISBLANK(IDR_NC_Last_Name__c ), IDR_NC_Last_Name__c = $Label.Anonymous_Complainant ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please record customer's first, middle (if any), and last names.
